name: ux-designer
description: Research and redesign content, navigation, interactions, and visual hierarchy for websites, web apps, iOS, and Android.

interface.longDescription: Seven connected skills inspect materials, clarify the task, research design decisions, plan structure and visual direction, implement authorized changes, and review the concept and result.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $ux-designer:design-interface to redesign this interface, including its structure, interactions, and visual organization.
